# LRF-IMU

> Code-only public release, version 1.0.0. `exact_paper_reproduction=false`.

## Paper identity

- Title: A latent rectified flow approach to generate synthetic wearable data – a LABDA solution
- Authors: Amin Rezaei; Morten Kjærgaard; Jasper Schipperijn
- Journal: Machine Learning: Health
- DOI: 10.1088/3049-477X/ae91ef

## Repository map

- `README.md`: researcher entry point, installation, and core commands.
- `DATA_ACCESS.md`: external REALDISP access responsibility and expected ideal-log layout.
- `REPRODUCIBILITY.md`: evidence levels, workflow, manifests, and limitations.
- `MODEL_CARD.md`: model scope, intended use, and unsupported claims.
- `docs/RESULTS_REPRODUCTION.md`: regenerated evaluation and analysis results.
- `docs/KNOWN_DISCREPANCIES.md`: unresolved historical evidence conflicts.
- `configs/paper/`: six-channel, accelerometer-only, and sensitivity configurations.
- `src/lrf_imu/`: preprocessing, VAE, Rectified Flow, generation, evaluation, analysis, and reproducibility orchestration.
- `contracts/`: machine-readable source, parity, and runtime evidence.
- `tests/`: synthetic fixtures, parity checks, packaging tests, and safety scanners.

## Core commands

```text
python -m pip install ".[training,evaluation,analysis,test]"
python -m lrf_imu vae-smoke
python -m lrf_imu flow-smoke
python -m lrf_imu prepare-data --data-root <realdisp-root> --held-out-subject 1 --sensor-configuration six_channel --validate-only
python -m lrf_imu evaluate --data-root <realdisp-root> --sensor six_channel --classifier rf --held-out-subject 1 --scenario trtr
python -m lrf_imu reproduce-core --data-root <realdisp-root> --checkpoint-root <checkpoint-root> --output-root <external-output> --all-folds --dry-run
```

## Evidence and artifact boundary

- Audited task: REALDISP ideal placement, right-thigh IMU, 50 Hz, four activities, 12 LOSO folds, main window/hop 160/40.
- Six-channel and reconstructed three-channel preprocessing use separately trained checkpoints; 3CH is not an inference-time channel drop or proof of exact historical parser lineage.
- Paper/TSTR generation uses ten reverse-Euler steps. Website trajectories use a separate 100-step visualization profile.
- Privacy results are threat-model-specific empirical observations, not anonymization or general privacy guarantees.
- REALDISP data, participant-derived windows, checkpoints, generated arrays, trained evaluators, historical `Results/` payloads, manuscript files, and figures are not included.
- Historical reproduction requires user-supplied REALDISP access and matching external checkpoints.
